title: Clicking browser back button jumps back to first page of results
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

I'm implementing custom routing with Vue router but having an issue with the browser back button jumping back to the first page of results. The issue is seen here in this [sandbox](https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/github/algolia/doc-code-samples/tree/master/vue-instantsearch/routing-vue-router)

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

Click through the pagination to go to a few different pages and then click the browser back button. It doesn't take you back to the previous page of results you were on, it takes you back to the first page.

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/github/algolia/doc-code-samples/tree/master/vue-instantsearch/routing-vue-router

### 💭 Expected behavior

I expect to be take back to previous page of results not the first page.

### Package version

"instantsearch.js": "^4.77.3", "vue-instantsearch": "^4.20.4", "algoliasearch": "^5.20.2",
